protocol: pretrained ULTRA vs Enterprise-source-finetuned ULTRA on unbridged, entity-disjoint CAPEC/CWE/CVE target
source_graph: MITRE Enterprise ATT&CK v19.2, frozen source train/valid/test splits

target_graph_audit.protocol: pretrained ULTRA -> source-finetuned ULTRA on an unbridged, entity-disjoint CAPEC/CWE/CVE target KG

split_config.method: seeded greedy edge holdout preserving every entity in train

cve_sampling.method: sort CVE IDs by SHA-256(f'{seed}\0{CVE_ID}') and take first max_cves

cross_domain.claim: Unbridged cross-KG relational transfer; no identity or mapping links are asserted between source and target entities.

metrics_and_scope.primary_metric: filtered target test MRR over head and tail corruption, all target entities as candidates
metrics_and_scope.comparison: pretrained zero-shot ULTRA vs Enterprise-source-finetuned ULTRA on identical target queries
metrics_and_scope.interpretation_limit: This tests transfer to a separate target KG without shared entity IDs or explicit semantic bridge edges; it does not directly test attack detection or prove broad transfer to all cybersecurity KGs.

message_passing: source or target training triples only; all non-has_weakness target triples are context; no bridge edges
model_selection: source Enterprise validation MRR only; target validation/test never select source checkpoint
primary_metric: filtered target test MRR delta on held-out CVE has_weakness CWE triples, ranking heads and tails over all target entities
final_acceptance_requires: mean delta-MRR >= 0.03 and both seed-level t CI and hierarchical paired-bootstrap 95% CI entirely above zero
